title: Nandiya
text: 1. Kapilavatthu nidānaṃ || || 2. Ekam antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Nandiyaṃ sakkam Bhagavā etad avoca || || Catuhi kho Nandiya dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti- okatamehi catuhi || || 3. Idha Nandiya ariyasāvako Buddhe- -{saṃvattanikehi} || || 4. Imehi kho Nandiya catuhi dhammehi- -niyato sambodhiparāyano ti || ||
